notes.title: BCD!?: 2.3 Weapon changes, new arctic track and character!
notes.notes:
[h1]Removing some weapon combinations.[/h1]
I have done a lot of experimenting with the weapon combo system and have come to the conclusion that it is too complicated. After getting a lot of feedback I found people really struggled to remember all of the different combinations. Because of this I am lowering the weapon combinations to same item only (from 14 total to 8 total). If you pick up two of the same item, it changes to a super power item. After play testing this I found people picked up the game much more easily, were able to be more tactical and remember the combinations. I hate removing content, but I genuinely feel that it makes the game better, if you have any feedback on this please let me know in the forum. I will change the description page to match the changes made.

Improvements have been made to the second tier weapons so they all work as intended. Some more work is still to come for the visual side. Animations for the mushroom drop and chicken attack still need work as well as more particle effects and SFX for all weapons.

[h1]New Player Character[/h1]
I have added the polar bear to the roster of playable characters! You can change your character any time in the hub world by pressing select on your gamepad and then moving left/right with the analogue stick to switch between characters!

[h1]New Arctic Track[/h1]
A new arctic track has been added to the game! Check it out in the arctic hub world.

[h1]Second tier drift[/h1]
If you hold the drift for long enough you now get a second tier hit of speed. You get much more speed but a lot less control.

[h1]Minor Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added clover to forest world
[*]Foliage interaction in the forest world
[*]Mushroom drop throws you into the air
[*]Some bears have crowns in the hub world when they shouldn’t
[/list]

As always, thanks for checking out Bears Can’t Drift!? and let me know what you think of the game in the forums :)

Thanks,
Arran
Dev

notes.title: BCD!?: Mini Update 1.2
notes.notes:
Hello again my fellow bears :) Many people on the forums have been asking for a graphics control panel so I spent a bit of time putting one together. You can access it by pressing "Select/back" on the gamepad or "enter" on the keyboard.

[h1]Control Panel features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fullscreen
[*]vsync
[*]Screen resolution
[*]Quality settings; Low, Medium, High
[/list]

[h1]Change log[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added visual cues to Boost X Shield
[*]Added visual cues to Hive X Shield
[*]Added visual cues to Boost X Boost
[*]Hive X Boost now drops multiple hives
[*]Boost start now works
[*]Fixed music not looping
[*]Improved bump off surroundings
[*]No more confetti for last place
[*]Spawn location issues in single race
[*]Mortor shots now hit the player and targets lead bear.
[*]Added a quality setting control panel.
[*]Esc key now closes the game
[*]Basket visually depletes when you drive through
[*]Enemy AI can now use all weapons
[/list]

[h1]Next Update Plans[/h1]
The next update is going to be a big one! Update 2.0 will be coming in the next couple of weeks and unlocks the arctic hub world and sci-fi monitoring station. Thanks again for all your feedback so far :)
